verses.zh: 美名胜过大财；恩宠强如金银。
verses.kjv: A good name is rather to be chosen than great riches, and loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.en: A good name is worth more than great riches, and being well thought of is better than silver and gold.

verses.zh: 富户穷人在世相遇，都为耶和华所造。
verses.kjv: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD is the maker of them all.
verses.en: Rich and poor have this in common: the LORD made them both.

verses.zh: 通达人见祸藏躲；愚蒙人前往受害。
verses.kjv: A prudent man foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.en: A sensible person sees trouble coming and hides; a simple person walks on and suffers for it.

verses.zh: 敬畏耶和华心存谦卑，就得富有、尊荣、生命为赏赐。
verses.kjv: By humility and the fear of the LORD are riches, and honour, and life.
verses.en: Being humble and respecting the LORD brings riches, honour and life.

verses.zh: 乖僻人的路上有荆棘和网罗；保守自己生命的，必要远离。
verses.kjv: Thorns and snares are in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.en: Thorns and traps lie on the path of a twisted person, but whoever guards their life stays far away.

verses.zh: 教养孩童，使他走当行的道，就是到老他也不偏离。
verses.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.en: Teach a child the way they should go, and even when they are old they will not leave it.

verses.zh: 富户管辖穷人；欠债的是债主的仆人。
verses.kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.en: The rich rule over the poor, and whoever borrows becomes the lender's servant.

verses.zh: 撒罪孽的，必收灾祸；他逞怒的杖也必废掉。
verses.kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.en: Whoever plants trouble will harvest disaster, and the stick of their anger will be broken.

verses.zh: 眼目慈善的，就必蒙福，因他将食物分给穷人。
verses.kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.en: A generous person will be blessed, because they share their food with the poor.

verses.zh: 赶出亵慢人，争端就消除；纷争和羞辱也必止息。
verses.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.en: Send the mocker away and the arguing goes too; quarrels and insults stop.

verses.zh: 喜爱清心的人因他嘴上的恩言，王必与他为友。
verses.kjv: He that loveth pureness of heart, for the grace of his lips the king shall be his friend.
verses.en: Whoever loves a pure heart and speaks kindly will have the king as a friend.

verses.zh: 耶和华的眼目眷顾聪明人，却倾败奸诈人的言语。
verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.en: The LORD's eyes watch over knowledge, but he overturns the words of cheats.

verses.zh: 懒惰人说：外头有狮子；我在街上就必被杀。
verses.kjv: The slothful man saith, There is a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.en: A lazy person says, "There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the street!"

verses.zh: 淫妇的口为深坑；耶和华所憎恶的，必陷在其中。
verses.kjv: The mouth of strange women is a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
verses.en: The mouth of a woman who is not your wife is a deep pit; anyone the LORD is angry with falls into it.

verses.zh: 愚蒙迷住孩童的心，用管教的杖可以远远赶除。
verses.kjv: Foolishness is bound in the heart of a child; but the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.en: Foolishness is tied up in a child's heart, but loving correction drives it far away.

verses.zh: 欺压贫穷为要利己的，并送礼与富户的，都必缺乏。
verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his riches, and he that giveth to the rich, shall surely come to want.
verses.en: Squeezing the poor to get rich, or giving presents to the rich, both end in going without.

verses.zh: 你须侧耳听受智慧人的言语，留心领会我的知识。
verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.en: Listen carefully to the words of wise people, and set your heart on what I teach,

verses.zh: 你若心中存记，嘴上咬定，这便为美。
verses.kjv: For it is a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
verses.en: because it is good to keep them inside you and have them ready on your lips.

verses.zh: 我今日以此特特指教你，为要使你倚靠耶和华。
verses.kjv: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.en: I am teaching you this today so that you will put your trust in the LORD.

verses.zh: 谋略和知识的美事，我岂没有写给你吗？
verses.kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.en: Have I not written excellent things for you, full of advice and knowledge,

verses.zh: 要使你知道真言的实理，你好将真言回复那打发你来的人。
verses.kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
verses.en: to show you what is true and certain, so you can give a true answer to whoever sent you?

verses.zh: 贫穷人，你不可因他贫穷就抢夺他的物，也不可在城门口欺压困苦人；
verses.kjv: Rob not the poor, because he is poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.en: Do not rob a poor person just because they are poor, and do not crush someone in need at the city gate,

verses.zh: 因耶和华必为他辨屈；抢夺他的，耶和华必夺取那人的命。
verses.kjv: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.en: because the LORD will take up their case, and will take the life of whoever robbed them.

verses.zh: 好生气的人，不可与他结交；暴怒的人，不可与他来往；
verses.kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.en: Do not make friends with a bad-tempered person or spend time with someone who rages,

verses.zh: 恐怕你效法他的行为，自己就陷在网罗里。
verses.kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.en: or you will learn their ways and get yourself caught in a trap.

verses.zh: 不要与人击掌，不要为欠债的作保。
verses.kjv: Be not thou one of them that strike hands, or of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.en: Do not shake hands on someone else's debt or promise to pay what they owe.

verses.zh: 你若没有什么偿还，何必使人夺去你睡卧的床呢？
verses.kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.en: If you cannot pay, why should the bed be taken from under you?

verses.zh: 你先祖所立的地界，你不可挪移。
verses.kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
verses.en: Do not move the old boundary stone your ancestors set up.

verses.zh: 你看见办事殷勤的人吗？他必站在君王面前，必不站在下贱人面前。
verses.kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean men.
verses.en: Do you see someone who works hard at their job? They will stand before kings, not before nobodies.
